postal_system.assignment_rule: The UPU South Africa addressing sheet defines four digits below the delivery locality or post-office name. For a physical address the code identifies a delivery locality; for rural and postal-delivery-service addresses it identifies the Post Office. A code and locality pair are text assignment evidence, not automatic polygon membership.
postal_system.delivery_type_rule: Every assignment records physical, rural, PO Box, Private Bag or separately documented special delivery semantics. Street and box codes may differ and are never collapsed merely because the locality label matches.
postal_system.geometry_rule: Canonical geometry is an official rights-cleared postal surface only where an exact source defines one. Otherwise the code has an official office point, delivery-locality reference or no canonical geometry. Locality, suburb, municipality, ward, census geography, nearest-office partition, address interpolation, Voronoi cell and model output stay derived, uncertainty-bearing and non-canonical.
postal_system.address_rule: House or delivery-point number, street or village, building or complex details and delivery locality form physical or rural address evidence. PO Box and Private Bag are separate postal delivery endpoints. None of these alone identifies a resident, recipient, occupant or exact building footprint.
postal_system.building_rule: Exact building display requires a rights-cleared authoritative building feature and a source-defined stable relation, common identifier or reviewed explicit crosswalk to the exact civic address. A postal code, locality, parcel, aerial image, topographic feature, containment, overlap, text similarity or nearest-building result creates candidates only.
postal_system.administration_rule: Stats SA, municipal or NGI geographies provide separately versioned administrative or mapping context. Province, district, municipality, ward, main place, subplace and enumeration area are not postal delivery areas unless SAPO explicitly establishes the relation.
postal_system.licence_rule: Website visibility, search output, viewer access, the Spatial Data Infrastructure Act or government custodianship never by themselves grant bulk extraction or repository redistribution. Every artifact pins the exact owner, product licence, access method, attribution, derivative rights, retention, edition, coverage, schema, CRS and digest.
postal_system.privacy_rule: PO Box or Private Bag holders, recipients, contacts, correspondence, shipment history, residence, occupants, owners, tenants, title, rights and user queries are excluded from public artifacts.
postal_system.crs_rule: Every spatial artifact retains its source CRS, axis order, epoch and accuracy. Hartebeesthoek94, Lo zones or a product-specific projected CRS are never relabelled WGS84. EPSG:4326 output requires a reviewed, versioned transform and accuracy statement.
postal_system.territory_rule: The repository uses ISO code ZA and source-stated Republic of South Africa coverage. Postal and geospatial coverage do not decide sovereignty, municipal jurisdiction or service obligations; borders, islands, enclaves, informal settlements and gaps are not model-filled as official.
postal_system.freshness_rule: SAPO codes and delivery types, post offices, civic addresses, buildings, administrative boundaries, geodetic products and licences refresh independently. Mixed-edition joins fail closed unless valid-time, known-time and the explicit relationship overlap.

integration.coordinate_flow: coordinate -> exact permitted civic-address point or postal-office point -> typed postcode candidate -> delivery locality -> administrative context -> explicit address-building relation -> ZA AGID cell
integration.postcode_flow: canonical four digits plus delivery type -> pinned SAPO assignment -> official area, office point, locality reference or no canonical geometry -> optional derived surface -> explicit civic-address/building relation -> AGID cells
integration.building_output_gate: source-defined stable address-building relation, common identifier, or reviewed explicit crosswalk required

quality_gates.pass: Exactly four digits remain text; prefixes, punctuation and shorter or longer values are rejected.
Physical, rural, PO Box and Private Bag assignments remain typed; identical locality text never merges them.
Only an exact rights-cleared postal authority surface is canonical; office and locality points stay points.
Method, inputs, uncertainty, exclusions, topology, version, time and digest are recorded; output stays derived and non-canonical.
Exact building output has an authoritative relation or reviewed crosswalk; containment and proximity alone never pass.
Source CRS, zone, axis order, epoch and reviewed transform are pinned per product.
Exact product licence, access, attribution, derivative, retention and redistribution conditions are pinned.
No delivery-endpoint holder, recipient, correspondence, resident, occupant, owner, title or query data is published.
Synthetic fixtures verify behavior but never satisfy production evidence gates.

stages.definition: Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.
A complete rights-cleared SAPO code, locality and delivery-type artifact passes coverage, freshness, licence and digest gates.
Official or derived geometry and public civic-address artifacts pass authority, uncertainty, privacy, CRS, validity and redistribution gates.
Exact permitted building geometry and explicit civic-address joins pass identifier, ambiguity, privacy and quality gates.
